R0233.title: Collaborative Document Link Exposure
R0233.definition: Cloud drives, documents, IM files, or knowledge bases remain exposed for long periods through shared external links.
R0233.description:
Collaborative document link exposure comes from cloud drives, online documents, messaging files, or knowledge bases configured with public links, long validity, or forwarding permissions. Once a link leaks, outsiders may access content without an account.

Collaboration tools make sharing easy but hide permission boundaries. Organizations need sensitive document detection, public sharing restrictions, expiration controls, and access anomaly monitoring.
R0233.influence: Long-lived public document links can expose customer data, project plans, credential screenshots, and internal procedures.

observables: Cloud-drive or knowledge-base documents are set to public links with long-lived validity
Externally shared documents contain customer data, credential screenshots, or internal processes
Public links are batch-accessed by external IPs without an account
Collaboration document external links lack expiry or permission boundaries
External-link access sources diverge from normal collaboration patterns with unfamiliar-region clusters
